dataset.name: Madagascar malaria (chap-models/XGBoost_for_Malawi)
dataset.description: Monthly malaria cases in children under 5 for 21 health centres (CSB) in Ifanadiana district, Madagascar, with rainfall, temperature and a bed-net timing covariate, from the PIVOT PRIDE-C project via chap-models/XGBoost_for_Malawi.
dataset.notes: Repo is named Malawi but the data is Madagascar. The file is the same as chap-models/Madagascar_ARIMA input/trainData.csv, made by its data_preparation.R from PRIDE-C malaria-u5-modelData.csv (https://gitlab.com/pivot-dev/PRIDE-C/pridec-model, data/for-model/csb-cases/): csb -> location, n_palu -> disease_cases, rain_mm -> rainfall, temp_c -> mean_temperature, net_time added, kept 2016-07 to 2022-12. Data check: all 1638 rows match that source file (age_class u5) exactly. Locations are CSB (Centre de Santé de Base) catchments made of fokontany (PRIDE-C csb_catchment_secto); these are health facility areas, not an admin level, so admin_level is TODO. population is a placeholder of 1. admin_level is null: locations are health-centre (CSB) catchments, not admin units. PRIDE-C has a real pop column (~600-1300 per CSB, likely under-5) that could replace the placeholder 1.
dataset.schema_status: scaffold: values marked TODO are not verified

fields.name: location
fields.description: Health centre (CSB) name; values are the CSB catchment areas.

fields.name: disease_cases
fields.description: Malaria cases in children under 5 recorded in the CSB registers, per CSB catchment and month.

source.notes: PRIDE-C n_palu, age_class 'u5'; scripts/adj-incidence/01_clean-data/01_health-data/01_clean-csb-register-data.R aggregates malaria cases from the CSB registers. Equals source for all rows.

fields.name: rainfall
fields.description: Monthly precipitation from ARC2, averaged over the fokontany of the CSB catchment.

source.notes: PRIDE-C rain_mm from data/env-dynamic/from-smaller/precip-arc2.csv ('precipitation from ARC2' in 01_historic-env-dynamic.R); xx_create-model-dataset.R averages fokontany values per CSB. Data: 0 to 507, about a quarter of values are 0.

fields.name: mean_temperature
fields.description: Average monthly temperature from MODIS land surface temperature, averaged over the fokontany of the CSB catchment.

source.notes: PRIDE-C temp_c from data/env-dynamic/from-smaller/tempc-modis.csv; 01_historic-env-dynamic.R: 'temp_c : average monthly temperature in C' (section 'Temperature from MODIS LST'). Data: 15.8 to 27.5.

fields.name: net_time
fields.description: Time since the last mass bed-net distribution campaign (campaigns assumed on 2015-08-01, 2018-08-01 and 2021-08-01): (days since campaign + 1) / 365.

source.notes: Formula in chap-models/Madagascar_ARIMA data_preparation.R; reproduces all values to 5e-15.

fields.name: population
fields.description: Placeholder, all values 1. Not population data; do not use.

source.notes: Madagascar_ARIMA README: 'CHAP currently also requires a population column so I added a population column filled with ones'. All values are 1.
